## Phase

**build — active pivot.** MVP core build (Phases 1–6) shipped and closed long ago; the project
then ran a long post-MVP feedback/beta-hardening loop (dozens of client-filed bugs/features, all

## What this project is

Project Origins: a persistent ecosystem simulation where players guide life evolution through
species creation and environmental stewardship. MVP shipped as a deterministic, local-first
evolution sandbox. Now pivoting the play loop on top of that same engine — see Phase, above.
